text:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU queue alert: gpu-serving-prod-us-west-2 queue length 860 (threshold 150). cluster-autoscaler leader election failing, scale ops queued. Severity P1. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod-us-west-2/gpu-queue

Nora: Ack. Jumping in. Any deploys or customer spikes?

Maria G: No deploys. Traffic surge from travellytics-prod batch+realtime mix. Token/sec up ~3x. Correlating logs now.

Jing Wei: CA logs show leader election timeouts and frequent restarts: `leaderelection: failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded` and then `scaleUp: failed to process`.

Albert K: Pasting CA logs:
```
I0412 09:04:12.789 msg: acquiring lease
E0412 09:04:25.001 leaderelection: failed to update lease: operation canceled
E0412 09:04:25.002 main: leader election lost, exiting
```

Nora: Cluster check — CA pods restart loop, api-server 95th latency ~650ms, pending gpu pods 390. Looks like API throttling + CA instability.

incident-bot: New event — kube-scheduler reports `Insufficient resources: nodes are all tainted` for podset gpu-serving; pending pods growing.

Maria G: Customer impact: travellytics-prod showing tail latency >30s and 5xx spikes on realtime endpoints. CS notified.

Jing Wei: CloudWatch shows STS attachRoleRate exceeded spikes around 09:02: sudden attach failures causing nodes to be marked unhealthy by ASG; CA then retried and flapped.

Albert K: Ops plan: 1) create emergency hot-spare nodegroup with pre-baked instance profile (bypass attach flow) 2) remove NoSchedule taint on hot-spare 3) roll CA restart to reestablish leader 4) if ASG still unhealthy, temporarily increase ASG desired.

Nora: Doing step 1 and 3 now. Maria please own customer bridge and comms. Jing confirm STS errors and open quota ticket.

Nora: Running create-nodegroup (command omitted). Nodegroup creation in progress.

Albert K: Patch CA deployment to increase leader-election leaseDuration to 30s and restart one pod at a time.

incident-bot: Update — 4 new nodes from hot-spare joined and became Ready. They inherit taint `dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule`.

Maria G: Removing taint so pods can schedule: `kubectl taint nodes -l eks.amazonaws.com/nodegroup=gpu-hotspare dedicated=gpu:NoSchedule-`

Nora: Done. Pending pods dropped 390 -> 60 in 2 minutes. Latency 95th down from 5.6s -> 1.2s. 5xx rate falling.

Jing Wei: STS throttling still visible but less impactful since new nodes used baked profile. I'll file infra ticket for STS limits and add exponential backoff to attach flow.

Albert K: CA leader stabilized after rolling restart. Logs show single leader and scale operations processed.

Maria G: Posted initial customer update: brief, blameless, ETA for full RCA. CS and account execs looped in.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated (P1->P2). Follow-ups created: infra (Jing) for STS limits, runtime (Albert) for CA leader tuning and automation, product (Maria) for customer comms. Handoff scheduled to Sam in 30m.

Nora: Handoff notes: runbook actions executed: manual nodegroup, taint removal, CA rolling restart. Collect metrics: attachRole error rate, CA leader election failures, api-server latency, pending pod histogram. Next steps: automate hot-spare, increase STS quotas, revert temporary CA lease change after fix.

Sam: Ack. I'll take postmortem and follow-ups tomorrow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
